sentences.text:
This Miscellaneous First Appeal Is
Filed Under Section 173(1) Of M.V. Act, Praying To Enhance The Compensation
Amount Payable To The Appellant By Suitably Modifying The Judgment
AND AWARD DATED 28.01.2021 PASSED BY THE COURT OF IV-ADDL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MEMBER, MACT-XV, VIJAYAPURA IN MVC NO.50/2019 IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the Appellants/Claimants and the representative of Respondent-Corporation along with its counsel are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The Appellants/Claimants have agreed to receive and the Respondent-Corporation has agreed to pay a lump-sum of compensation of Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakhs only), in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal, in full and final settlement of the claim.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.

3. Out of the enhanced amount, a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- shall be released in favour of claimants and the remaining amount of Rs.5,00,000/- shall be kept in Fixed Deposit in the name of the claimants in any nationalized bank or schedule bank of claimants' choice for a period of three years and the claimants would be entitled to withdraw quarterly interest.
The apportionment, deposit and release of amount ordered by the Tribunal shall hold good for the compensation awarded in this appeal.

4. The Respondent-Corporation has agreed to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of Award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
5. The Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the award accordingly.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
